Join Angular GDE Brooke Avery for practical tips and strategies on navigating Agile, managing priorities, and improving software delivery. Ideal for software engineers seeking to elevate their coding practices without abandoning their IDE.

online.title: DevFest:Extended Boston
online.blurb: DevFest:Extended in North America invites 80 developers to dive into graph engineering. Build autonomous agent teams for data-driven campaigns and ad optimization. Ideal for tech enthusiasts seeking practical experience in multi-agent systems. Limited seats, one day only.

online.title: An Enterprise Adoption Story: Translating Google AI into Real-World Outcomes at Dublin City University (DCU)
online.registration: Free registration with Bevy Virtual Conference
online.blurb: How does a leading university turn cutting-edge Google AI into tangible daily impact for thousands of staff and students? Join GDG Athlone on November 10th as Niall Spollen (DCU) shares the practical playbook for driving real-world enterprise AI adoption, automated workflows, and digital transformation.

online.title: For Business Owners: Business Operations Automation with AppSheet
online.blurb: This session shows business owners how to use Google AppSheet to digitize and automate their internal operations without hiring a developer or learning to code. If you can build a spreadsheet, you can build an app in AppSheet. And if you can build an app, you can automate the processes that are quietly draining your time and energy every single week.

online.title: Accelerating Agent Deployment on Google Cloud with the AlisX Platform
online.blurb: Join GDG Pretoria and Alis Exchange for a virtual workshop on deploying AI agents using Go and Google Cloud. Led by AI specialist Nicholas Breckwoldt, the event targets developers and AI enthusiasts. Gain practical experience and access to Google Cloud. Registration is required. Happening 11 Nov, 18:00-21:00.

online.title: Nuevos paradigmas en el flujo del desarrollo con la IA
online.blurb: En esta  charla aprenderás a dominar el desarrollo asistido por IA con Antigravity y Open Spec. Descubre cómo reducir tokens hasta un 90 %, evitar código defensivo mediante KISS y validaciones con MCP y SonarQube, y coordinar subagentes para resolver fallos complejos sin saturar el contexto.
